title: Lenny Winnemuller
text:
I'm Lenny Winnemuller, based in Amsterdam. I graduated with honors in psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specializing in group behavior, and also hold a degree in entrepreneurship. I've worked as a professional in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada, and today I invest independently.

I teach long-term investing in the Canadian trader education program of Peak Capital Trading, where I help students build the discipline and frameworks that long-term investing requires.

**My mission:** I give people honest and responsible financial education, so they enjoy learning about the economy, the philosophy of investing and themselves, and learn to invest independently for the long term.

**My vision:** A world in which people have the financial, philosophical and psychological knowledge to build wealth responsibly and make better choices with their money.
section_title: Why I teach investing as a skill
section_text:
Long-term investing isn't about finding the next big idea, rather it's a skill. Making good decisions, consistently, for years. Like any skill, it can be developed and learned, but it takes the right method, deliberate practice and someone who gives you honest feedback along the way.

I never tell anyone what to buy or give buy recommendations. I teach you how to make your own well formed decisions, so you never have to believe any story again.
